text.p: Yates becomes a powerful typhoon and threatens the Marianas. Typhoon Yates has intensified to 130 mph and will further intensify to near 155 mph during the next 24-36 hours. During that time, the storm, now east of the Mariana Islands near 16n/151e, will track west southwest to west northwest, reaching the central Marianas as a supertyphoon. Yates will be an extreme danger to shipping and eventually to the Mariana Islands as it brings destructive winds and very heavy rains.

Tropical Depression 29W has formed in the Philippine Sea, west of Guam, near 15n/138e. The storm has top winds near 35 mph and is tracking to the northwest about 20 mph. This system is expected to intensify into Tropical Storm Zane within 24 hours and should be centered well east of the Philippines. This will mainly threaten shipping during the next day or two but could threaten north Philippines later in the week.
There are no further statements at this time.
